join.title: Find your event photos
join.hint: The code is printed on the QR card
welcome.cta: Take a selfie to find your photos
welcome.consent: By tapping, you agree your selfie is used only to find your photos in this event.
welcome.privacy: Your selfie is deleted right after the search
welcome.not_ready: Photos are being added. Please check back soon.
welcome.expired: Photos for this event are no longer available.
welcome.not_found: Event not found. Please check the code.
selfie.title: Take your selfie
selfie.hint: Keep your face inside the circle, in good light
selfie.camera_blocked: Camera didn't open. Use the button below to take a selfie.
photos.none_hint: Try again facing the camera in good light
privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.p1: Your selfie is used only to find your photos in this one event and is deleted right after the search.
privacy.p2: Face data from an event is never shared with any other event.
privacy.p3: Tap “Not me” on any wrong photo, or ask us to remove you from a photo.
privacy.p4: Event photos are deleted automatically when the event's plan ends.
err.no_face: We couldn't see a face. Try again in good light.
err.multiple_faces: Keep only your face in the camera
err.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait a little.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.offline: No internet. Please check your connection.
err.event_not_found: Event not found. Please check the code.
err.search_expired: Session ended. Please take a selfie again.
err.image_too_large: Photo too large. Please try again.
err.event_expired: Photos for this event are no longer available.
err.event_not_ready: Photos are being added. Please check back soon.
err.bad_image: Couldn't read the photo. Please try again.
profile.save_body: Save your number — photos from any new event you add will be found automatically.
profile.consent_body: We store an encrypted face code (numbers), never your photo. It is used only for events you add yourself, and you can delete it any time.
profile.saved: Saved! Your photos are now in “My events”
login.title: Enter your mobile number
login.privacy: Only for the OTP — no password, no spam
me.title: My events
me.empty: No events yet. Scan a QR code or enter an event code below.
me.no_face: No face code saved. Take one selfie so your photos are found automatically.
me.delete_face_confirm: Your face code and all matches will be deleted. Are you sure?
me.shortcut: Show my photos — no selfie needed
me.none_yet: No photos of you yet. We'll message you on WhatsApp when new ones arrive.
gallery.title: Your photos
